Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 13
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner swapped the directors’ birth years from the Wikipedia pages—incorrectly stating David Butler was born in 1893 and Lambert Hillyer in 1894. The sources show Butler (1894) and Hillyer (1893), so this misrecording led to the wrong conclusion that The Whistle’s director was born later.
